basics.name: ABDULLAH BIN AHMED
basics.label: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Architect
basics.summary: Data-driven Senior Business Intelligence Analyst with 5+ years of experience overseeing the design, development, and delivery of enterprise BI solutions. Expert in architecting SQL databases, automating Power Query workflows, and deploying highly accessible Power BI dashboards that enable executive decision-making. Proven track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, establishing data warehousing practices, and aligning technical data outputs directly with high-priority company objectives to eliminate operational waste.

Set priorities aligned with company objectives by analyzing product expiration trends via structured SQL-ready data formats, directly reducing inventory waste by 60% year-over-year.

Secured the accuracy of application analytics by executing strict Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and advanced SQL queries to patch dysfunctional database relations.
